steps: Open the new menu starter in real Studio, inspect exact TXT in Chinese/English/Japanese at 390px, cancel without writes, then explicitly create and ordinarily save the new script and registration. No target_scene_id export exists.

Manage the existing level behavior through Studio: preview/cancel leaves all bytes untouched; explicit Save adds exactly one reviewed script reference to the behavior registration without changing its source.

Add a fresh binding to the player and select the newly linked script. Explicit Add missing supplies exactly title, items_json and display_mode. Three-language 390px views show all three defaults with no target parameter. Cancel discards the new binding and every local row without author writes.

Add a different fresh binding, explicitly Add missing, edit menu mode, bounded item JSON and multilingual display text, inspect three-language narrow layouts, Check and Apply. Every existing binding byte range remains exact. Apply writes no author file; ordinary Save changes only the level behavior source.

Reload and reopen retain the explicit source, instance, three explicit parameters and fresh identity. The ordinary four-scene build snapshot is valid, the script remains exact, and the retained author-final workspace matches saved UI bytes. Official sample and all guarded production source hashes stay unchanged.

pause-script-zh-CN.title: 新建脚本
pause-script-zh-CN.description: 用 title、items_json 和 display_mode 配置内置菜单。scene 模式支持切换、重试、原地重开与结束；paused 模式支持恢复与结束，并要求同场景绑定官方暂停脚本。每模式最多一个菜单、1至8个按钮；使用鼠标或键盘选择，恢复前等待松开操作。只创建普通脚本，不提升玩法权限。

pause-script-en.title: New script
pause-script-en.description: Configure the built-in menu with title, items_json and display_mode. Scene mode supports switching, retrying, restarting the current scene and ending the run. Paused mode supports resuming and ending, and requires the official pause script in the same scene. Each mode allows one menu with 1 to 8 buttons. Select with the mouse or keyboard; release controls before resuming. Creates an ordinary script without granting gameplay privileges.

pause-script-ja.title: スクリプトを新規作成
pause-script-ja.description: title、items_json、display_modeで内蔵メニューを設定します。sceneモードではシーン移動、リトライ、現在のシーンの再起動、実行終了を選べます。pausedモードでは再開と終了を選べ、同じシーンに公式の一時停止スクリプトが必要です。各モードのメニューは1つ、ボタンは1〜8個です。マウスまたはキーボードで選択し、再開前に操作を離してください。通常のスクリプトのみ作成し、ゲーム操作の権限は拡張しません。

limitations: Actual Chrome and Studio HTTP editor on a disposable reference-game fixture. This is not from-blank project creation, installed Tauri or Android acceptance.
The menu TXT, registration, relation, binding and three parameter rows are absent at the recorded start; each is created through ordinary Studio controls. Original sample files remain untouched.

The fixture copies the previous 102-file pause author unchanged, then explicitly maps pause only to P and the existing initializer action to separate legacy_start/KeyL in the disposable copy. Existing loop audio and ordinary tick probes remain. Browser evidence claims no native gameplay.
Exact-source parameter hints remain advisory. Explicit Add missing, local editing, Check, Apply and ordinary Save are distinct operations; Cancel never writes.
